errors.message: Transformation error: required value "purchaseOrderNumber" resolved to undefined at $.beginningSegmentForPurchaseOrder[0].purchaseOrderNumber

customer_note: We changed our order export to send po_number instead of poNumber. Now the mapping breaks. Can you fix it on your side?

hypotheses.hypothesis: The export renamed poNumber to po_number; the mapping expression $.order.poNumber now resolves to undefined and purchaseOrderNumber is required
hypotheses.check: Open ?tab=errors and compare the raw inbound key with the mapping expression

hypotheses.hypothesis: The export only sends the PO number on some order types, so this is intermittent rather than a rename
hypotheses.check: Check whether other POs from today mapped correctly

mock_result.customer_reply: The mapping that turns your order export into an 850 reads the field poNumber. Your export now sends po_number, so the PO number comes through empty and the transaction fails as Invalid. We will update the mapping to read po_number, and read both names so this does not repeat if the export changes back. I will confirm here once it is live, and you can resend from then on.
